title: WEBBOTICS Universal Task Language (UTL) Schema v2.0
description: Formal schema for hardware-agnostic physical task payloads. Part of the Techmanity Stack — Layer 22 (WEBBOTICS). Invented by Rashon Rahming, Techmanity Foundation. © 2026.

task_id.description: Globally unique task identifier. Recommended format: UTL-{UUID4}.

intent_description.description: Human-readable description of the overall task intent.

priority.description: Task priority level. 1 = lowest, 10 = highest. Default: 5.

simulation_required.description: If true, the executing robot MUST run a digital twin simulation before physical execution.

confidence_threshold.description: Minimum acceptable confidence score [0.0, 1.0] for task execution. Below this, execution is aborted.

authorization.description: TIP v9.0 authorization envelope. References the operator's DID and signature.

operator_did.description: W3C DID of the authorized human operator.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical SHA-256 hash of the task payload.

economic_terms.description: WEBBIUM v1.1 economic settlement terms for this task.

bounty_r.description: Task bounty in Rahmn Economic Units ($R) for stable pricing.

penalty_wbm.description: $WBM penalty deducted from robot's stake on verified failure.

steps.description: Ordered sequence of UTL action steps.

UTLStep.description: A single executable step in a UTL task.

step_id.description: Unique identifier for this step within the task.

condition.description: Python-evaluable condition expression. Step executes only if condition evaluates to True. Sandboxed with no builtins.

on_failure.description: Failure routing policy for this step.

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum seconds allowed for this step before it times out.

description.description: Human-readable description of this step's intent.

SuccessCriteria.description: Defines how task success is evaluated against world model state.

sensor.description: For sensor_reading: the sensor name to query.

object_id.description: For sensor_reading and pose_verification: the object to evaluate.

expression.description: For sensor_reading: Python comparison expression evaluated against the sensor value (e.g., '> -3dBm').

target_pose.description: For pose_verification: expected final pose [x, y, z] in meters.

tolerance_m.description: For pose_verification: acceptable distance tolerance in meters.

value.description: For boolean type: the required boolean state.

description.description: Human-readable description of what success means.
